ignorePatterns.comment: Optional private sibling; not present in umst-formal-only CI checkout
In-file anchors are not HTTP URLs; tool otherwise false-positives 404
GitHub Actions badge URLs return 502 when workflow has no runs yet

replacementPatterns.comment: A DOI link asserts that the DOI is registered; doi.org's handle API answers that directly. Following the redirect to the landing host (zenodo.org) times out from GitHub-hosted runners (status 0).
